button.label: Reset group

text.name: T_SSAtmoCloudPuffsPerCell
text.tool_tip: How many puffs the field places in each 260m cell it keeps. Lower thins the field toward one body per cell; higher fills the same cells more thickly. It does not open holes - that is the sky's coverage - and it costs nothing in the far field, which already collapses to one puff per cell

slider_bar.name: SB_SSAtmoCloudPuffsPerCell
slider_bar.tool_tip: How many puffs the field places in each 260m cell it keeps. Lower thins the field toward one body per cell; higher fills the same cells more thickly. spinner.name: S_SSAtmoCloudPuffsPerCell
spinner.tool_tip: How many puffs the field places in each 260m cell it keeps. Lower thins the field toward one body per cell; higher fills the same cells more thickly. It does not open holes - that is the sky's coverage - and it costs nothing in the far field, which already collapses to one puff per cell

text.name: T_SSAtmoCloudPuffBudget
text.tool_tip: Most puffs one cloud deck may draw at once. Over budget the field keeps the nearest and drops the farthest, so lowering this pulls the deck's far edge in rather than thinning the sky overhead
